entry.title: Sanctions and the Militarisation of Ukraine's Children
entry.content: Russia’s mass abduction and militarisation of Ukrainian children is a grave abuse. This Feature assesses how far current sanctions address the problem and argues for broader measures that target the camps, officials, businesses and banks enabling it.

entry.title: Revision to FATF Recommendation 8: Impacts on Sub-Saharan Africa

entry.content: Conflict financing sits at the heart of many grey- and blacklisted jurisdictions, yet the FATF has never treated it as a distinct, cross cutting risk. In this Professional Insight, the author calls for a dedicated report on how wars are funded, to guide more nuanced, risk-based responses and strengthen the organisation’s credibility with conflict affected states.
